content: AI stock prediction apps (Tickeron, TrendSpider, AltIndex) commonly surface: confidence scores/percentages per prediction, published backtested accuracy stats (e.g. ~70-75%) with out-of-sample validation, Sharpe/Sortino ratio comparisons vs buy-and-hold, and multi-timeframe/multi-asset backtesting. Accuracy claims are a major marketing lever but require careful framing to avoid overpromising.
